channel.title: Courtney Thomas — Journal
channel.description: Notes from the page: Courtney Thomas on faith, healing, loss, purpose, and the books that came out of hard seasons.

item.title: Keeping what love leaves behind
item.description: Children grieve in the middle of playing. On Finding Drake's Feather, and why a kept feather is a real answer to an impossible question.

item.title: Grace for ordinary days
item.description: Early alarms, the commute, the guilt that arrives after the children are asleep. What 365 Days of Grace offers a working mother who is out of proof.

item.title: A garden still growing
item.description: Seeds, storms, waiting, pruning. The four movements of Rooted in Purpose, and why a garden is an honest way to think about a life.

item.title: How to read The Price Series
item.description: Choosing You, then Letting Go, then What We Keep — why the order matters, and what each book is actually asking of Kathryn.

item.title: Surviving into story
item.description: Some of the most powerful stories are born from the things we never thought we would survive. On the long distance between living through a chapter and being able to write it.
